note: Policies, programs, notices, outages and deadlines a voicemail may fall under. causes and obligations are the demo's ground truth (for the mock and the tests); keywords are where a quote can come from.

rules.name: Form 22-B re-verification
rules.description: Form 22-B asks for address and income re-verification; payments are held until it comes back.

applies: I got the 22-B letter, what do I need to send?
not: I sent Form 14 for direct deposit.

rules.name: Portal sign-in outage (error 4012)
rules.description: Since this morning the portal rejects sign-ins with error 4012; a fix is under way and callers need not call again.

applies: I can't log in, it says error 4012.

rules.name: Payment date moved to the 12th
rules.description: From March, payments for this group arrive on the 12th instead of the 3rd.

applies: My payment didn't come on the 3rd this month.
not: My payment was the wrong amount.

rules.name: Returned deposits are reissued
rules.description: A deposit returned by the bank is reissued by check about 10 business days after the bank details are updated.

applies: The bank sent my payment back.

rules.name: Identity check hold
rules.description: Payments pause while an identity check is open; it clears when the documents are matched.

applies: My payment is on hold for an identity check.

rules.name: Congressional inquiries: 5 business days
rules.description: An inquiry from a member of Congress's office gets a written answer within 5 business days.

applies: My congresswoman's office is calling you about my claim.
not: I'm going to write a complaint.

rules.name: Overpayment waiver
rules.description: Someone told they were overpaid can ask for a waiver; collection pauses while it's decided.

applies: I got a letter saying I was overpaid.
not: I was paid less than usual.

rules.name: 2025 cost-of-living letters
rules.description: The 2025 cost-of-living adjustment letters, mailed in January 2025.

applies: What's this cost of living letter?
